quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 next step 引出的第一步计划

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力推理题中按动作顺序还原说话人的下一步计划。

major_issues: Existing flip card hides the checkable answer on the back instead of giving the learner an answerable front-side task.
The task asks for a plan summary but does not force the key order distinction between contact first and arrange later.
No quality_metadata is present, so source/audio and review status are not explicit.
minor_issues: Audio file quality is not formally reviewed; current review only covers text/task design.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as an auto-scored multiple_choice card that tests the first next-step action.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 根据 likely to 和 unless 判断可能后果

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户在后续可能题中保留语气强度和条件限制，避免把可能性听成绝对事实。

major_issues: Existing multiple_choice answer is directionally usable, but the analysis is template-heavy and does not teach likely to / unless clearly enough.
The card lacks quality_metadata, leaving simulated source and TTS boundaries implicit.
Distractor rationale should explicitly separate probability, cancellation, and condition errors.
minor_issues: Keep the core answer but rewrite prompt, analysis, and metadata for sample review.
cards.recommendation: Retain the transcript and answer direction, but make the inference rule and condition handling explicit.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 区分已完成背景和 next thing 引出的下一步计划

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户从背景句切换到计划句，完整保留后续计划中的并列动作。

major_issues: Existing timing-click task is downcast to flip, so the front promises a click action the product contract does not actually expose here.
The back-side answer window cannot serve as a self-contained front-side learning task.
The card should test the plan introduced by The next thing we will do rather than timing-window behavior.
minor_issues: Original time_window_ms is unsuitable for this candidate sample branch because audio timing has not been formally reviewed.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as multiple_choice to separate completed background from the next planned actions.

batch_review.box_progression: The existing first three cards do not yet form a clean recognition -> application -> transfer progression for 后续计划/可能.
repetition_or_gap_risks: Two cards depend on back-side or timing-window answer revelation rather than front-side solvable choices.
Source and TTS status are not explicit in quality_metadata.
batch_review.next_step: Revise only the first three cards as a candidate sample and keep it out of approved_batches until explicit user confirmation.
